text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"states a clear negative position in the opening and closing","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It takes and maintains a definite argument throughout the essay instead of drifting among copied facts and fragments."},{"evidence":"uses the article’s liability and law concerns in separate body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It presents its reasons in a recognizable structure with an introduction, body support, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"explains why accidents would be hard to assign fault for","quality":"reasoning","description":"It goes beyond repeating facts by connecting them to a claim about why driverless cars would create problems."},{"evidence":"mentions driver alertness, new laws, and pedestrian safety","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It develops multiple supporting points rather than offering only isolated statements."},{"evidence":"includes a concluding restatement of the main argument","quality":"conclusion","description":"It closes by summarizing its position and tying the reasons back together."}]}
